rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an unsafe condition (icy walkway), which is a classic premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's home during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury premises liability claim requiring urgent adjuster assignment.

case_facts.incident_type: slip and fall on icy walkway
